note:
ROUND 3 of the explainer for /pages/firming-skin-density — templates/page.firming-skin-density.json, section `content`, block `causes`, 'What Causes Loss of Firmness?'.

MALCOLM, 2026-08-25: 'full-depth-density-falling-away-luma_02 looks to be the best option. but lets do the cross section of the skin square from the front and zoomed in more. and if we are using this image as the fix version then lets make sure the cross section has similar layers.'

SO THE CONCEPT IS SETTLED AND ONLY THE CAMERA AND THE CROP ARE IN PLAY. Rounds 1 and 2 offered three different pictures; this round offers ONE picture from three distances, because the choice left to make is how close, not what of. The r2 palette carries over unchanged — skin and nothing else — and every negative from r2 is kept verbatim.

THE LAYER STACK IS TRANSCRIBED FROM luma_02, NOT PARAPHRASED. Read off the winning frame at full size, top to bottom, and written into every slot in this order so the engines cannot reshuffle it:

  1  QUILTED SURFACE   soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach, slightly
                       felted and matte — the only textured surface in the frame
  2  SMOOTH FILM       a thin band of pale cream, faintly laminated at the cut edge
  3  GRANULAR BAND     a thick layer of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely, reading on
                       the cut face as a fine foam of tiny cells — the deepest band of the upper slab
  4  BASE PLATE        a thin smooth peach plate closing the underside of that slab
  --- open gap ---
  5  FIBRE LAYER       long thick glossy PEARL-WHITE bundles in loose parallel horizontal waves,
                       lying in open space with clear air above and below them
  --- open gap ---
  6  DERMAL FLOOR      a second thin smooth peach plate
  7  FAT CUSHION       two rows of large smooth glossy rounded lobules, pearly cream-blush, packed
                       like a bed of eggs
  8  GLASS BASE        a clear colourless acrylic plate the whole block rests on

THE GAPS ARE PART OF THE PICTURE. In luma_02 the strata float slightly apart with clear air between them rather than sitting welded in a solid stack, and that separation is doing real work — it is what makes the block read as having LOST density rather than as a textbook diagram. Slots A and B keep it; slot C deliberately closes it up, as the one alternative worth offering, and is flagged as such rather than assumed.

CAMERA: SQUARE ON, FROM THE FRONT. This is the actual change. luma_02 is a low three-quarter view showing both the top surface and the cut face; Malcolm wants the cut face itself, straight on. So the block is level and parallel to the film plane, its cut face square to the camera, with no perspective convergence and no top surface visible beyond — at most — the thinnest sliver along the upper edge. The quilted surface therefore survives as a narrow band at the top of the frame rather than as a plane, and the brief says so explicitly, because an engine given 'front elevation' and 'quilted top surface' in the same sentence will tilt the camera back up to show it.

ZOOM: THE BLOCK FILLS THE FRAME. In luma_02 the block occupies about half the height with a great deal of empty ground above it. Here it runs edge to edge horizontally and fills nearly the full height, so the strata are large enough to read at the 660px the block renders at on the page. Three distances are offered: A the whole stack, B closer with the upper slab cut by the frame edge, C the whole stack compacted.

GENERATED REFERENCE-FREE, DELIBERATELY, EVEN THOUGH A REFERENCE EXISTS. luma_02 could be attached as a style reference, and normally would be. It is not, because the one thing being changed IS the camera angle, and a reference locked to a three-quarter view fights the instruction that asks for a front elevation — the engines would reproduce the angle and ignore the words. The layer stack is pinned by the transcription above instead. FLUX.2 also stays in the run this way, which an attached reference would exclude.

EVERYTHING ELSE CARRIES OVER FROM r2: square 2048x2048 (the row height in `media-with-text` is set by the master's own aspect, so anything else makes this block taller than its five siblings); the r3/matrixyl house register of smooth glossy CGI, high-key on a pale hazy ground, soft diffuse light, no hard shadow; no lettering, arrows or callout furniture of any kind; the family's delivery spheres, light shafts, peptide chains and starburst glints stay negated because this block is the damage and the next block on the page is the repair; no before-and-after split, contrast is a smooth gradient across one continuous block; no MMP drawn as a character, degradation shown as its evidence.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AGAIN AT RENDER SIZE. The r2 failure mode was texture coherence, and a front elevation raises the risk: a wall of horizontal pearl bundles seen flat-on is one step from noodles, piping or a woven mat. Those terms are negated and the check is mandatory before anything is published.

slots.title: A · square-on front elevation, the whole stack filling the frame, gaps kept
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level with the middle of the block and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges perfectly horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface of the block is NOT seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver of it shows along the upper edge. The block runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge and fills nearly the whole height, so every layer is large and easy to read. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte; nothing in the frame is dyed or tinted.

THE LAYERS, FROM TOP TO BOTTOM, IN THIS EXACT ORDER:
Across the very top, a narrow band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted. Directly beneath it a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut. Beneath that a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely together, reading as a fine foam of tiny cells. Closing that upper slab, a thin smooth peach plate.

Then a clear open gap of empty air.

Below the gap, a layer of long thick glossy fibre bundles in a pale pearl ivory, almost white with only the faintest warm gold in their highlights, lying in loose parallel horizontal waves with clear air above and below them, so the layer floats between the slab above and the floor beneath. They are glassy, translucent and crisply lit against the matte tissue behind, separated from it by material and not by colour.

Then another clear open gap, and below it a second thin smooth peach plate. Resting on that, a deep cushion of large smooth glossy rounded lobules in a pearly cream-blush, packed in two rows like a bed of eggs. The whole block stands on a thin clear colourless glass plate.

EVERYTHING THINS FROM LEFT TO RIGHT, SMOOTHLY AND CONTINUOUSLY. At the left edge the granular band is dense and even, the fibre bundles are thick, numerous, brightly pearlescent and closely spaced, the cushion of lobules is deep and full and round, and the surface band above is level and taut. Travelling right, the granules loosen and begin to break away into a fine drift of tiny pale specks in the air; the fibre bundles become fewer and thinner and fray apart into loose splayed strands, their pearl lustre going dull, chalky and greyed-beige and their glassy surface turning matte, several parted with the ends drawn back and curled; the gaps between them widen until they are mostly empty space; the lobules shrink and flatten into a run of much smaller beads and slump downward, leaving a soft hollow beneath the layers above; and the surface band, unsupported, sinks into a long slack downward curve.

The change is a slow even gradient across one continuous block — no line, no seam, no join, no division, nothing repeated and nothing mirrored. Nothing is arriving and nothing is being rebuilt. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, a shallow depth of field softening the far side of the block. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
